themes.name: Amane Wagashi
themes.description: An elegant, quiet store theme for a small Kyoto-style wagashi (Japanese confectionery) house that makes a different sweet each month, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Blush washi paper, pale azuki panels, deep azuki-brown ink and a muted azuki red; Kaisei Tokumin for display, Plus Jakarta Sans for text. A magazine masthead (H5) with a quiet dateline that shows the season of the site's own calendar (Late autumn · Month of the chestnut, from the WordPress timezone through a block binding), the house name in large type beside a small round azuki seal and a ruled menu row. The home page is built around a sideways-scrolling seasonal tray (L4): twelve months of sweets, January camellia to December yuzu, each a framed card with photograph, month, name, note and price, scroll-snap, keyboard and touch scrollable, plain-anchor earlier/later and month links, this month marked In season now. Seasonal calendar (all twelve months as a grid) and Pre-orders pages (choose a box, pick a day, collect or delivery; editable Most chosen badge), plus shop, about, journal, newsletter and contact. The footer (F6) is a street sketch with one pin beside a quiet visit and pre-order card. The shop address, hours, telephone, email and pre-order cut-off are one synced pattern (masthead dateline, footer card, Pre-orders, Contact); the twelve sweets with prices are one synced pattern (home tray, Shop, Seasonal calendar). WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows the tray and orders go by telephone or email.

The footer opens with a slow, pauseable "today at the space" ticker in Fragment Mono (static for reduced motion), then the space details and links. A thin ochre engawa rail with joints divides sections. With The space, Plans, Events, Tour booking (a request form that composes an email), Journal, Newsletter and Contact. themes.name: Tsuki Silver
themes.description: An elegant, restrained store theme for a small silver jewellery atelier, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Moonstone blush paper, muted rose panels, ink text and soft silver reflections; Sorts Mill Goudy for display, Questrial for text. A floating pearl pill header (H10) with the wordmark, menu, account and cart. The home page puts the pieces first (L11): a short title and the five product families marked by moon phases drawn in CSS (new, crescent, half, gibbous, full), then straight into a rhythmic grid of pieces on pale stone (a 2 x 2 feature, pairs of squares and one wide tile), the atelier, sizing and care, the journal and the letter. Ring sizing (four ways, a US size table, free resizing) and Care (four habits, what silver dislikes, free re-polishing) pages; atelier, journal, newsletter and contact pages. The footer (F12) is a stamped round seal and a vertical line of italic text beside the wordmark, the menu and the visit rows of the synced atelier card. The address, hours, telephone, email and the sizing and care notes live in one synced pattern used by the footer, Ring sizing, Care and Contact; every product shows its metal line, kept once as a product attribute (WooCommerce optional: without it the home grid and the shop page show the synced tray and orders go by email).
themes.deviation: Palette, fonts, style tags and H10 + F12 + L11 are as planned (combination unused: Kaori Cosme is H10/F3/L1, Hikari App H10/F2/L6, Kami no Ne H3/F12/L8, Menya Kaen H11/F12/L7, Komugi Pan H2/F8/L11, Ginrin Cycle H6/F10/L11). Muted rose #A07873 is 3.5:1 on blush (2.8:1 on the rose panel), so it is kept to moon marks, hairlines and large marks; links, labels, italic heading accents and the seal use deep rose #6E4E4A (6.6:1 on blush, 5.2:1 on the rose panel), secondary text quiet ink #5E5455 (6.5:1 on blush, 5.2:1 on the rose panel); ink #2E2A2A is 12.7:1 on blush. Pearl #FBF8F7 cards, soft silver #C9C1BF hairlines and pale rose #D9BDB8 were added. H10 differs from Kaori Cosme and Hikari App by a pearl pill with a silver edge, a crescent mark before a Goudy wordmark, centred spaced-capital menu and a rose cart chip; on phones wordmark, Menu and cart stay on one line inside the pill. F12 differs from Kami no Ne and Menya Kaen by a round SVG seal (ring text and a crescent, tilted like a stamp) in deep rose beside a vertical italic line on the muted rose panel. L11 differs from Komugi Pan and Ginrin Cycle by a moon-phase category index under a short title and a four-column grid on pale stone with a 2 x 2 feature tile and a wide tile every eight pieces, a silver sheen on hover (none with reduced motion). Both fonts verified OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name (google/fonts ofl/sortsmillgoudy, ofl/questrial) and subset to Latin WOFF2 (~83 KB). The Care page uses the existing generic page tag care-guide (the existing tag care is labelled Knife care); the page itself is /care/. Industry silver-jewellery and page tag ring-sizing are new. The eighth product photo (Waning Dome Ring) is a crop of the atelier bench photograph. Added a newsletter page because check-themes requires it.

themes.name: Yuge Sento
themes.description: A serene, airy hospitality theme for a family-run neighbourhood bathhouse (sento), told as one single-column long read through an evening at the bath. Pale tile, misty blue and blue ink with a slate blue used only for numerals, rules and marks; a deeper blue for links and buttons. A slim bar docked at the bottom of the screen holds the Zen Antique Soft wordmark, the menu and today's hours with an Open now / Closed · opens 15:00 / Closed today chip worked out on the server from the site's timezone; on phones it is the wordmark, the chip and a Menu button that opens a full-screen menu read from the bottom up. The home page is a centred reading column: the opening with this evening's hours, five chapters (the curtain, the tiles, the mural, the water, cold milk after) each a short essay and one photograph, a word from the keeper, tonight's prices and the journal, divided by a small three-tile mark. The footer is a tiled waterline over a quiet street plan with the bathhouse marked by its steaming chimney, beside the address card. A faint bath-tile grid texture runs through the bar, the price card and the menu. With An evening, Bath guide (five customs, what to bring), Prices (passes, bring your own), Journal, Newsletter and Visit (a message form that composes an email, no backend). Hours, closed day, address, phone and email are edited once in Appearance > Bath details; the price list is one synced pattern. Zen Antique Soft over Be Vietnam Pro. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
